messages:
maria: Morning — micro async update.
What I did: landed the quickstart CLI tweaks (removed duplicated flags), pushed docs for the new 'init' flow, and rebased sample-ruby.
Blockers: CI is flaking on the samples e2e job (seems related to docker networking), and I need a second set of eyes on the CLI help text changes.
Today: debug e2e, follow up on PR comments, and polish the quickstart markdown for Windows instructions.

aj: Thanks — saw the CLI PR, left a couple nits about examples. I can take the e2e flaky job look after lunch. Any consistent repro?
	maria: repro isn't consistent; happens ~1/6 runs. Error in the job log: ``failed to connect to 172.17.0.1: dial tcp: i/o timeout``. Re-running sometimes clears it.
	sam: pinging here because sample-embed demo is choking on the new SDK patch. Error in node console: ``TypeError: client.embedding is not a function`` — maybe the SDK surface change wasn't propagated to sample.
	maria: ah — sample uses the old client import. I pushed a tiny change to the sample that uses `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey })` instead of `require('redwood')`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/412.
	leo: I'll review that PR. Also FYI, doc-bot ran the lint sweep overnight and caught a couple of missing code fences in quickstart windows notes.
	doc-bot: auto-lint: docs/quickstarts/windows.md — added missing ```bash``` fences. (CI: passed)

	aj: Quick note — can we add a small test that hits the sample-embed init path to reduce regressions? I can add a minimal smoke test to the samples CI.
	maria: yes please, that would help. If you add it, tag me and I'll wire up the credentials for the canary run.
	sam: for the SDK surface: I opened an issue tracking the compatibility matrix between v0.9 and v1.0 (docs + migration snippet). https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/87
	leo: for the e2e flake, I'll try to reproduce locally with Docker Desktop networking on. If I can replicate, I'll open a minimal repro and we can loop infra.
	maria: thanks — also, small docs ask: can someone eyeball the Windows quickstart commands for PowerShell syntax? I got one report that `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` confused folks.
	aj: I can do that — will change examples to include PowerShell and bash forms.
	sam: assigning the sample-embed cleanup to myself and the migration issue to the SDK squad. ETA EOD for the sample fix.
	maria: sweet. If CI passes after the sample PR, I'll merge and then re-run the samples e2e to see if the flake persists.
	doc-bot: deploy-notice: docs site scheduled rebuild at 15:30 UTC. No action needed.
	leo: noted. If anyone needs me to pair on the Docker repro, ping me in thread or DM.
	maria: last thing — small release note we should add: "samples: update SDK import and clarify quickstart PowerShell steps." I'll draft a one-liner after lunch. :memo:
	aj: cool. Low priority: open PRs list — I'll triage and mark any docs PRs that need edits.
	sam: thanks team.
	maria: great progress — feel free to drop short updates here. I'll follow up with CI results later.
